content: YouTube Data API v3 quota (2026-06 docs): default allocation is 100 search.list calls/day in a dedicated bucket (cost 1 unit per search call under the new scheme) PLUS 10,000 units/day combined for all other endpoints. PROJECT.md's 'search costs 100 units' assumption is OUTDATED — the old 100-unit search cost no longer applies; search.list has its own 100/day bucket at 1 unit/call. videos.list costs 1 unit from the shared 10k pool. Use part=snippet and fields filtering to trim payloads. Invalid requests still cost >=1 unit. Daily quotas reset midnight PT.
